summary: S8 Payments screen frontend testing complete. All 10 requested scenarios PASS: sidebar navigation routes to /reports-module/payments without Coming Soon toast; 4 KPI cards render with live data (Total Settled ₹3,52,155 / 318 orders / 7 days, Cash ₹1,10,487 = 31.4%, Digital ₹2,13,131 = 60.5%, TAB ₹9,714 = 2.8%); donut chart renders 6 colored slices (#329937 Cash green confirmed) with interactive tooltips; method performance cards show Cash/Card/UPI/TAB/Partial/Other with revenue + order count + % badge + avg; daily stacked bar chart renders 29 segments across 7 days; cash vs digital area chart renders 2 area paths with gradients; daily table headers exact match [DATE, ORDERS, TOTAL, CASH, CARD, UPI, TAB, OTHER] with TOTAL footer (₹3,52,155.00); date presets Today/7D/30D/MTD all clickable and reload data; download dropdown opens with Excel/PDF enabled and Email/WhatsApp/SMS disabled per spec; back button navigates to /reports-module/dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentsMockup.jsx is 657 lines — file-size threshold (>700) not yet breached but trending; consider extracting chart sub-components (DonutBlock, StackedBarBlock, TrendAreaBlock, DailyTable) for future maintainability.

Recharts emits benign console warnings 'width(-1)/height(-1)' when the download dropdown briefly forces a re-layout. Not user-impacting but could be silenced by gating ResponsiveContainer behind a visibility check.

Razorpay classifier defaults Razorpay→UPI which biases the Digital split if any Razorpay row is actually a card payment without 'card' hint — acceptable per stated business rule but worth a one-line code comment for future auditors (already commented).
All interactive elements have data-testid coverage — excellent test hygiene.
seed_data_creation: None — used live preprod.mygenie.online API data for Cafe 103 (restaurant #644).
context_for_next_testing_agent: S8 Payments screen is fully functional. Sidebar pattern: expand-sidebar → sidebar-insights → sidebar-insights-payments. Live data load takes ~6s after navigation. All payments-* data-testids verified working. The PaymentsMockup.jsx uses the same orderLedgerService data source as S6/S7. For future S9+ screens, expect the same sidebar collapsed-by-default pattern and ~15-20s login bootstrap delay.
